ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn.
   B. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an.
   D. Say Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Types of Divorce? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of Divorce.
   B. Apply the teaching of Types of Divorce with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Types of Divorce to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Types of Divorce has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Types of verses? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Types of verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Types of verses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Types of verses has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of verses.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Say Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an.

7. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Cheating in exams

8. Which response best shows understanding of Asbabu al- nuzuul? (1 mark)
   A. Use Asbabu al- nuzuul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Asbabu al- nuzuul.
   C. Say Asbabu al- nuzuul has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Asbabu al- nuzuul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

10. Which response best shows understanding of Care for widows? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Care for widows with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Care for widows to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Care for widows.
   D. Say Care for widows has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Prayers on special occasions? (1 mark)
   A. Use Prayers on special occasions to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Prayers on special occasions has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prayers on special occasions.
   D. Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Administration of Zakat? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Administration of Zakat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Administration of Zakat has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Administration of Zakat.
   D. Use Administration of Zakat to insult classmates of other faiths.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Funeral Rites? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Funeral Rites with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Funeral Rites to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Funeral Rites has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Funeral Rites.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.
   B. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

15. Which response best shows understanding of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected verses Surah al- Furqan.
   B. Use Selected verses Surah al- Furqan to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Selected verses Surah al- Furqan has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Selected Hadith and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Prayers on special occasions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Funeral Rites and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Administration of Zakat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Divorce and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
